The policy on screen

3 Oct 2026 WP3

Every rule of the loaded policy with its limit, the live value and a status, a banner for the latest event, and a north-up map with the no-fly zone. Here the follow controller is routing around the zone by itself.

▶Video citylife_redcar_nfz_policy_hud.mp4 (22.0 MB) is not hosted on this site yet.

Video: following the red car past a no-fly zone

3 Oct 2026 WP3

A 240 s flight in the CityLife city with the policy indicator. The drone never entered the zone and kept the car within 30 m for 98.5 % of the mission (98.7 % on a flight without the zone, at the same 10 m cruise height; 8.8-43.6 % on 7 earlier flights with the old target selection).

Shield off and on: ArduPilot SITL + MAVROS 2

28 Aug 2026 WP3

Top-down tracks of the same waypoint mission. Without the Shield the path crosses the no-fly zone (3.7 s inside); with it, the repaired path goes around (0.0 s). One desktop, the grant's dev topology.

Target identity: before and after

30 Sep 2026

Share of served ticks on which the drone's estimate of the red car was within 6 m of the car. 7 earlier flights, replayed with the old estimator: 1.3-69.7 %. 4 flights with the identity layer: 99.6-100 %.
